### E&F Currency Merge -- GENERATED FILE, DO NOT EDIT
### Rebuild with tools/regen_ef_currency_merge.py after any E&F or hotfix update.
###
### Source: the 98 bank companies E&F itself lists in private_bank_type,
### ordered by CENTRAL_BANK_COMPANY -- see historical_central_banks in the
### generator for why that table decides order and not membership.
###
### Two additions each, and nothing taken away:
###
###   building_bank -- `building_types` is the only real lock on who may own a
###   building, and any of these can end up holding a central bank. Without it
###   the add_ownership in zz_ef_cm_bank_ownership.txt has nothing to hand the
###   bank to and the country's own bank never takes it over.
###
###   the three regime currencies -- E&F's own prestige goods are left in place;
###   they sit on other base goods (manufacture_stock and friends) and never
###   compete with the three currencies, which all share spe_uni_c.
###
### INJECT:, which can only add, and that is now enough. For one round this file
### was 98 REPLACE: blocks carrying E&F's full definitions, in order to strip
### building_railway and building_trade_center -- 7,000 lines of E&F's text to
### re-diff on every update. These are ordinary companies that happen to be
### eligible for a central bank, not central banks as such, so they keep the
### buildings E&F gave them.
